mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_memory_score (user_id, best_passed_count, best_streak, max_stage, achieved_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bestPassedCount}, #{bestStreak}, #{maxStage}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, s.best_passed_count AS score, s.best_streak AS secondaryScore FROM game_memory_score s LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id ORDER BY s.best_passed_count DESC, s.best_streak DESC, s.achieved_at ASC, u.nickname ASC
